title: Feedstock and Capacity for EV Battery Recycling in the EU, 2024-2030 (Institute for Circular Mobility)
text:
Abstract
This study models feedstock and capacity for EV battery recycling in the EU-27. In 2025 recyclers received about 155,000 tonnes of EV-related lithium-ion material: roughly 120,000 tonnes of production scrap and 35,000 tonnes of end-of-life packs. We project 190,000 tonnes in 2026.

Capacity
Operating pre-treatment capacity was about 400,000 tonnes per year at the end of 2025, so average utilisation was below 50%. Refining capacity of about 140,000 tonnes per year is the real constraint on recovering lithium inside the EU.

Growth
Tonnage grew about 22% from 2024 to 2025 and is projected to grow about 23% in 2026. Revenue growth was lower than tonnage growth in 2024 and 2025 because metal prices fell.
